name: Choice of Dinosaur
source:
https://disastrophism.itch.io/choice-of-dinosaur

Choice of Dinosaur is a choose your own adventure game for the game boy color that follows the story of a carnotaurus trying to survive the cataclysm brought by the meteor.
translation:
https://disastrophism.itch.io/choice-of-dinosaur

《恐龙抉择》是一款面向Game Boy Color平台的互动式分支冒险游戏，讲述了一只食肉牛龙在陨石撞击引发的灭世浩劫中挣扎求生的故事。
